faq.question: What does Tehmina mean?

faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Tehmina an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Tehmina can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Tehmina should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Tahmīna is a Persian name, not a Quranic Arabic form.
